lines.en: And so another boring shift of sitting in the office and waiting for someone to show up begins.
Honestly, it’s a pain.
I don’t want to stay here any longer than they have to. I have...stuff to do.
But...
Of course, that isn’t always the case, though...
: Helloooo? Anyone in there?
Huh...That’s not a voice I recognize.
Maybe it’s a girl from one of the other classes looking for her teacher?
Or, better yet, maybe it's a cute new transfer student who’s gotten lost and is looking for someone to guide her around the campus?
: Huh...Guess no one is here after all.
: Wait, no. I’m here. You can come in.
I call out to who I hope is a transfer student and wait for her to enter the room.
: Hiya~ Nice office you’ve got here, Sensei.
: ...Karin?
Or...at least that’s what I think her name is?
: Uhh, no...I’m Kirin. Karin is my older sister.
: But...I guess I can let you off the hook since this is our first time actually talking.
: Our names are pretty close anyway, so it’s whatever.
: Right, right. Well, I’m sorry either way. It won’t happen again.
: Good. I’m going to hold you to that.
: So, Kirin, what brings you here today?
: Hmm...I don’t know. Boredom, I guess?
: I’ve never been in any of the counseling offices before, and my teacher is kind of a bitch sooo...I figured I’d come visit yours.
: That’s okay, right? It doesn’t look like you’re doing anything.
: What do you mean? I’m clearly very busy.
: Yes, yes. Of course you are. I can tell how much of a burden my presence must be, but I humbly ask you to let me hang out here for a little while.
: I mean, I’m fine with it, but why here? Don’t you need to be studying or something?
: Studying is boring. I want to do something fun.
: Normally people don’t come to the counseling room in search of fun.
: Really? Cause I could have sworn I heard these weird moaning sounds the last few times I’ve walked by.
: Uhh...
: It’s okay. You don’t need to hide anything from me. You can do whatever you want in here.
: It’s your office, after all.
: If you want to use it to have sex with your students, that’s totally cool. I won’t tell on you.
: This is...not at all how I expected our first conversation to go.
: Hmm...No, I guess it’s probably not.
: You’re really not going to tell anyone?
: Nahh. It’s more fun being in on secrets than exposing them.
: You should probably try and convince the girls to keep it down, though. If anyone else walked by, you would probably get in a lot of trouble.
Did...anything like that ever even happen in here, though?
And how would Kirin have even heard it if it did?
What sort of reason would she have ever had to come over here?
: Hey...can I ask you something?
: Whaaaat, you want me to engage in a secret relationship with you as well?
: Sensei! I’m shocked! We’ve barely even met and you’re already looking at me like a vulture looks at a dead rabbit.
: I was just going to ask you about your hearing...
: My...hearing?
: That’s so boring. Talk about something more fun.
: Fun isn’t really my strong suit. But if you want to stand here and continue flirting for a while, I seem to have gotten pretty good at that as of late.
: Is that what it is? I’ve been wondering why everyone’s been going crazy about you.
: Even Miku won’t shut up about you and she’s never even mentioned a boy before.
: Ahh, okay. I see what’s going on here.
: You’re not here to kill time. You’re just checking in to see what it is about me that’s making everyone fall for me, right?
: Hmm...Well, I guess that’s one of the reasons.
: Wait, roll back for a second. One of the reasons? How many are there? What do you want from me?
: Relax...It's just one more reason. And it’s a pretty simple one, too.
: ...Okay?
: Basically, I just need you to do something for me.
: And why exactly would I do anything for you? You’re not even one of my students.
: No, but I’m cute and I’ll probably have sex with you if you play your cards right.
: Well, when you put it that way...
: What do you need?
: Geez...boys really are easy, aren’t they?
: What you said can not be taken back. I hope you’re aware of that.
: Yeah, yeah. I know. I won’t take anything back.
: Besides, the favor I need today is pretty standard anyway.
: And what is this favor, Kirin?
: I need you to vouch for me whenever I don’t come to[school].
: This place is boring and I don’t want to come anymore.
: You think I’d risk losing my job for the chance of having sex with you?
: Yes. But, because I’m so nice, I’m willing to offer something else for today and today only.
: ...I’m listening.
: I will allow you to stare up the skirt of a mostly-innocent maiden for as long as you like. Please press H to hide the text box and get a better look at my panties.
: And also, please refrain from touching the goods until authorized. I have not yet provided consent.
: You can jerk off if you want, though. I don’t mind. You're probs hard as a rock now, right?
Jesus Christ, this girl is even more forward than Ayane. I didn’t realize that was possible.
Is this really what has become of [high_school] girls?
: Who the hell are you?
: Kirin Kanda! You promised earlier you’d remember!
: I know that...I just meant why are you being so calm about this?
: Your hands aren’t even shaking. Isn't that how this sort of thing normally goes?
: I’m holding up my skirt and you’re concerned about my hands?
: I should be the one asking who you are, not the other way around...
: Normally, yeah. But I’m kind of intimidated by your presence for reasons I don’t yet understand.
: Ugh...Why does everybody always say that?
: Can't you just do me a favor and vouch for me every now and then?
: You can just say that you’ve been tutoring me or something.
: I let you see my panties and promised I’d have sex with you eventually, so it’s not like you aren’t getting anything out of the deal.
: I probably would have said yes even if you didn’t do either of those things, to be honest.
: Really? I had you pegged as more of a 'You scratch my back, I scratch yours' kinda guy.
: I really did mean what I said about the sex thing, though.
: Like, I’m still a virgin and stuff, but I figure it’s about time I change that, right?
: Plus, if I pop my cherry before my sister, she’ll never be able to live it down. Heheh~
This[school] is fucking weird.
: Well, when you put it that way, there’s no reason for me to refuse.
: Great! So, we’ve got a deal then.
: You cover for me when I don’t come to class and I let you deflower me on your desk one day.
: My desk? Are we really doing it in here?
: I mean...it doesn’t really matter where we do it to me.
: I just figured you'd want your first time to be somewhere a litte more...I don't know, special?
: Special? Is that what it was like for you and Ayane?
: Sorry, but...why are you bringing up Ayane right now?
: Uhhh...I don’t know~
: Is this something you came up with on your own? Or is she going around and telling people that-
: Nahh. It's nothing like that. I’ve just got a certain way of knowing these things and the idea of you two not fucking each other is just wild to me.
: You two aren’t exclusive, are you? Like, will she freak out if you have sex with someone else?
: I mean...I imagine she would. But where’s the fun in a harem without the risk of something like that?
: Well said, Sensei~ Maybe the two of us can get along after all!
: You’ve left her waiting this entire time?
: Mhm. This seemed more fun, so...
: See ya, I guess!
: Feel free to think of my panties when you’re jerking off later! I don’t mind one bit!
What the fuck just happened in here?...
